applicabilityBasis.summary: HOME is marketed as a dollar stablecoin, but its mortgage-lien collateral, holder rewards, and protocol structure make payment-stablecoin treatment unresolved.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act proposed rule and Federal Register implementation materials
Federal Register and official U.S. regulator searches for HomeCoin and its issuer
Treasury foreign-issuer comparability and OCC registration materials
HomeCoin website, backing page, and whitepaper
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific U.S. PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered foreign-issuer exception was found for HOME as of 2026-08-14; the legal issuer and classification also remain unclear.

genius.notes: HOME is prominent enough to review despite its mortgage-backed reward and protocol features. No official GENIUS authorization was found, and its issuer identity and payment-stablecoin classification should be rechecked.
